name: Trello
description: Loads Trello boards, lists, cards, checklists and checklist items, and searches cards, with labels, members and due dates as fields.
introductoryText:
![Trello](data:image/png;base64,)

Loads data from Trello through its REST API. Fill in the ids for the outputs you want; each output is loaded only when its option is set.

- **Workspace id** gives the workspace's **Boards**.
- **Board id** gives the board's **Lists** and, unless a list id is set, every card on the board in **Cards**, with the name of its list.
- **List id** gives the **Cards** of that list instead.
- **Card id** gives the card's **Checklists**; **Checklist id** the checklist's **Items**.
- **Search** finds cards by text (up to 1,000) and writes them to **Search results**.

**How to set it up**: create a Power-Up at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin to get an API key, then generate a token from the key's page. A board's id is in its address after adding `.json` (https://trello.com/b/AbCd1234.json), or use the short code from the address (AbCd1234), which Trello also accepts.

options.name: apiKey
options.title: API Key
options.description: The API key of a Trello Power-Up: create one at https://trello.com/power-ups/admin, then open its API key page.

options.name: apiToken
options.title: API Token
options.description: A token generated from the API key's page (the Token link). The block sees what this token's account can see.

options.name: workspaceID
options.title: Workspace id (boards)
options.description: Load the workspace's boards. The id or short name from the workspace address, https://trello.com/w/your-workspace.

options.name: boardID
options.title: Board id (lists and cards)
options.description: Load the board's lists and, unless a list id is set, all its open cards. The id, or the short code from the board address (https://trello.com/b/AbCd1234).

options.name: listID
options.title: List id (cards of one list)
options.description: Load only the open cards of this list into Cards. A list's id is in the board's .json address.

options.name: cardID
options.title: Card id (checklists)
options.description: Load the card's checklists, with how many items each has and how many are complete. The id, or the short code from the card address.

options.name: checklistID
options.title: Checklist id (items)
options.description: Load the checklist's items with their state (complete or incomplete).

options.name: searchString
options.title: Search cards
options.description: Find cards by text across the boards the token can see (Trello's search syntax, such as label:Blog or due:week). Up to 1,000 cards.

blockOutputs.label: Cards
blockOutputs.tooltip: Cards of the list, or of the whole board, with the list name, labels, members, due dates and checklist counts

blockOutputs.label: Checklists
blockOutputs.tooltip: The card's checklists, with item counts (Card id)

blockOutputs.label: Items
blockOutputs.tooltip: The checklist's items and their state (Checklist id)
